data.title: Flutter & Android Engineer
description: Developed a cross-platform mobile app using Flutter to interface with IoT devices.
Integrated native Android (Kotlin) code into Flutter via platform channels to enable real-time video calling between the IoT device and mobile (iPhone/Android).
Built dynamic real-time charts (occupancy detection) synced from IoT sensors, optimized with stream-based data updates using WebSocket.
Implemented NFC-based login authentication via chip-embedded cards.
Built push notification system to deliver alerts (e.g., intrusion detection, weather updates) using Firebase Cloud Messaging.
Utilized GraphQL for efficient and structured device communication and data querying.
Supported features like live weather updates, intruder alerts, and user presence detection through sensor integration.
